title: DeepLRHE: A Deep Convolutional Neural Network Framework to Evaluate the Risk of Lung Cancer Recurrence and Metastasis From Histopathology Images.
summary: Deep convolutional learning from histopathology images predicted lung-cancer recurrence/metastasis risk and was evaluated in patient cohorts; it is a prognostic imaging result, not causal evidence.
